author: LGR
description:
XP is a QUARTER CENTURY old now... so let's jump back to 2001 for a retrospective review of the classic OS! Reminiscing on its retail release, exploring the packaging, setup process, new features, games, screensavers, and a bunch of nifty early 2000s things. It's still a truly enjoyable eXPerience decades later!
